identitySignals: Name matches: PG&E's own company profile page names the legal entity 'Pacific Gas and Electric Company'

OUSD's Sustainability Services page says 3 additional electric vehicle chargers were awarded to East Oakland Pride Elementary School through the PG&E Rebate Program, matching the agenda's East Oakland Pride Elementary EV Charger Installation Project
The OUSD page links to the PG&E EV Charge Schools program, matching the agenda's 'PG&E EV Charge Schools and Parks Program Contract'
PG&E is a utility serving Northern and Central California including Oakland, consistent with a facilities/electrical-charging contract
research.notes: Agenda lists San Francisco, CA, which was PG&E's former headquarters city; the company profile now lists Oakland. Same organization. Registry IDs and a mailing address were not verified, so they are left null.

profile.summary: Pacific Gas and Electric Company (PG&E) is an investor-owned utility that provides natural gas and electric service to about 16 million people across a 70,000-square-mile area of northern and central California. It is a subsidiary of PG&E Corporation and is headquartered in Oakland, California.

sources.title: Sustainability Services - Oakland Unified School District

review.notes: PG&E's company profile confirms the legal name, Oakland headquarters, 16 million customers, 70,000 sq mi territory, PG&E Corporation parent, phone and website; the OUSD sustainability page confirms the PG&E EV Charge Schools program and East Oakland Pride chargers, matching the agenda. The San Francisco agenda location is the former HQ city, so it is not a mismatch.
